findings.title: Unconstrained Polynomial Evaluation Witness Allows Fake State Proof Creation
findings.description: The ZK verifier circuit fails to enforce equality constraints between intermediate polynomial commitments and public inputs.

findings.title: EIP-712 Signature Replay Across Chains Due to Unchecked ChainID in Domain Separator
findings.description: The domain separator uses a cached chainId that is not refreshed on hard forks or cross-chain relay execution.
